features.name: range_atr
features.description: Sweep candle range divided by ATR

features.name: body_ratio
features.description: abs(close-open)/(high-low) of the sweep candle

features.name: lower_wick_ratio
features.description: lower wick / range of the sweep candle

features.name: upper_wick_ratio
features.description: upper wick / range of the sweep candle

features.name: close_location
features.description: (close-low)/(high-low) of the sweep candle

features.name: penetration_atr
features.description: ATR-normalized penetration beyond the liquidity level

features.name: reclaim_atr
features.description: ATR-normalized close reclaim of the liquidity level

features.name: wick_ratio
features.description: directional wick ratio of the sweep candle

features.name: sweep_volume_zscore
features.description: volume z-score of the sweep candle (causal, excludes current bar)

features.name: level_type
features.description: rolling | swing | equal | prev_day

features.name: level_age_bars
features.description: age of the swept level in bars as of the event bar

features.name: level_touch_count
features.description: number of touches on the swept level as of the event bar

features.name: bars_since_last_touch
features.description: bars since the swept level was last touched (NaN if never)

features.name: equal_level_dispersion_atr
features.description: (price_max - price_min)/ATR for equal levels, else NaN

features.name: level_is_previous_day_high_low
features.description: whether the swept level is a previous-day high/low

features.name: level_is_h1_swing
features.description: whether the swept level is an H1 swing level

features.name: level_already_partially_swept
features.description: whether the level was already swept/invalidated before this event

features.name: atr_percentile
features.description: causal rolling percentile of ATR (window 200)

features.name: volatility_regime
features.description: low | normal | high based on causal ATR percentile

features.name: volume_zscore
features.description: volume z-score of the sweep candle (excludes the current bar)

features.name: hour_utc
features.description: hour of the event in UTC

features.name: day_of_week
features.description: 0=Monday .. 4=Friday

features.name: session_asia
features.description: whether the event falls in the Asia session (config hours)

features.name: session_london
features.description: whether the event falls in the London session (config hours)

features.name: session_new_york
features.description: whether the event falls in the New York session (config hours)

features.name: h1_trend
features.description: sign of H1 EMA(50) slope using only closed H1 candles

features.name: distance_to_previous_day_high_atr
features.description: distance from event close to previous day high in ATR

features.name: distance_to_previous_day_low_atr
features.description: distance from event close to previous day low in ATR

features.name: confirmation_delay_bars
features.description: bars between sweep and confirmation

features.name: confirmation_range_atr
features.description: confirmation candle range in ATR

features.name: confirmation_body_ratio
features.description: confirmation candle body ratio

features.name: confirmation_volume_zscore
features.description: confirmation candle volume z-score
